integrity: The finite homology-length and automorphism statements are exhaustively replayed from the explicit facet list with exact bit-vector arithmetic. The integral torsion interpretation uses an explicit half-boundary cycle together with the published integral homology group.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the labelled vertex-transitive nine-vertex triangulation manifold_2_9_4_1. The result does not assert the same spectrum for the second vertex-minimal genus-five triangulation or identify the abstract order-18 automorphism group.
title: The orientation-torsion class is the unique six-edge homology class in a nine-vertex genus-five surface
